# TDI® USA

> 24/7 restoration services in Sacramento, CA.

TDI® USA (TDI® USA) is a professional restoration contractor serving Sacramento, CA and surrounding areas since 2017. We provide 24/7 emergency response for water, fire, mold, storm, biohazard, and reconstruction services. Phone: +19169666000 · Email: rob@tdiusa.com.
